Instrument is a digitally native design and technology company built to help brands unlock their full potential. Since 2005, our team of makers, thinkers, and storytellers has partnered with leading brands like Google, Nike, Uber, ŌURA, and Eventbrite to craft digital experiences that create impact and drive results.
Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t just design—we build. Our work lives at the intersection of taste and technology, powered by curiosity, thoughtful curation, and a commitment to delivering the most fitting solution for every brief. We bring this to life across three core offerings: Brand, Marketing, and Product.
As a member of our freelance network, you’ll collaborate with our teams to bring bold ideas to life—whether launching new brands, building digital products, or shaping experiences that move people. We welcome collaborators from all backgrounds and experiences who share our curiosity, creativity, and care for craft.
We believe great work comes from diverse perspectives and shared purpose. If you’re passionate about learning, experimenting, and making work that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Need:

    Instrument is looking for experienced freelance Product Designers to join upcoming digital product and experience work. These engagements may range from designing new athlete- or customer-facing experiences to translating a new visual direction into scalable templates, components, and documented design systems.

    You’ll partner closely with designers, strategists, technologists, producers, and client teams to turn complex journeys into clear, useful, high-quality digital experiences. Depending on the engagement and your level, you may own a substantial workstream, strengthen and document a design system, or provide hands-on design leadership across a team.

    We’re open to Senior Product Designers and Design Directors. Senior Designers should be able to independently own complex design work and contribute meaningfully to systems and team critique. Design Directors should also bring hands-on creative leadership, the ability to set a high bar across a workstream, and confidence guiding both teams and clients.

    Please share a portfolio with examples of product, platform, responsive web, or systems work. We’re especially interested in seeing how you moved from a complex problem or journey to a cohesive experience—and what you personally contributed.

What You'll Do:

    • Design polished, thoughtful digital product experiences across desktop and mobile
    • Translate user journeys, product requirements, and creative direction into clear flows, interfaces, and prototypes
    • Create, evolve, and document component-based design systems, including patterns, specifications, and reusable assets
    • Apply design systems consistently across templates and surfaces while identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve them
    • Partner with cross-functional teams to balance user needs, brand expression, technical feasibility, accessibility, and delivery constraints
    • Present work and articulate design decisions clearly in internal and client reviews
    • Support quality through implementation, collaborating with engineering partners to ensure the intended experience carries through to build
    • For Design Director-level engagements, guide design quality and direction across a workstream; mentor designers and build confidence with senior client partners

What You'll Bring:

    • Significant experience designing digital products, services, or complex responsive web experiences
    • A portfolio that demonstrates strong visual craft alongside sound UX and systems thinking
    • Deep fluency in Figma, including components, variables, libraries, prototyping, and clear documentation practices
    • Experience building or scaling design systems that are practical for teams to use—not simply beautiful libraries
    • Comfort working from foundational strategy, information architecture, or an established creative direction and bringing it to life across interconnected experiences
    • Strong understanding of accessibility and how to design inclusive, usable experiences across devices
    • Ability to work independently, manage a scoped workstream, and communicate proactively in a fast-moving engagement
    • Clear, constructive collaboration with other designers, strategists, technologists, producers, and clients

What We Offer:

    The expected contract pay range: $61-120 per hour. Contract compensation is determined by location, experience, and skillset. We have three regional pay ranges that are adjusted for cost of living (US1 +15%, US2 +7.5%, US3 Base), *learn more about our pay philosophy and cost of living adjustments.
    Benefits may be available in accordance with applicable law and company policy, including eligibility based on hours worked and duration of assignment.

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include high-growth startups, digital agencies, and innovative product-led companies across industries such as SaaS, FinTech, eCommerce, AI, and EdTech. Unlike traditional outsourcing models, you’ll be placed directly with a client as a valued, long-term member of their team.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer with 5+ years of experience in UI/UX and product design to lead the creation of user-centric digital products. This is a remote product design role where you will own the full design lifecycle—from discovery and research to high-fidelity design and iteration.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver seamless, impactful user experiences that drive engagement and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes: user research, wireframing, prototyping, and UI design
  • Define user flows, journey maps, and interaction patterns for web and mobile applications
  • Design high-fidelity interfaces that align with brand and usability best practices
  • Conduct usability testing and leverage data to inform design decisions
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing teams
  • Build, maintain, and evolve design systems and component libraries
  • Ensure designs are responsive, accessible, and scalable
  • Present design concepts and rationale clearly to stakeholders

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design, UI/UX Design, or Interaction Design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work
  • Proficiency in tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar
  • Solid understanding of user-centered design principles and UX best practices
  • Experience with design systems and scalable UI frameworks
  • Familiarity with data-driven design and experimentation (A/B testing)
  • Basic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Experience working in remote, cross-functional teams

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

About Sendmarc

We are a cyber security company that is on a mission to make the internet a safer place. We do this by delivering tooling and services related to an international standard, DMARC. Our technology enables organisations to protect their staff, customers, suppliers, and the whole world from email spoofing and impersonation attacks on their domains.

We’re a fully remote company with the majority of our builders working out of South Africa and sales teams in the Netherlands, the US, Latin America, Australia and the UK.

Why This Role Exists

The mission of this role is to create beautiful and user-friendly interfaces across Sendmarc’s digital products.

Sendmarc ships new capability fast, across a growing set of products and surfaces. This role exists to make sure every feature we ship is clear, consistent, and genuinely easy to use.

You’ll work alongside Sendmarc’s existing product design function, building out the design system that keeps our interfaces consistent as the product surface area grows, and working closely with Product and Engineering to take ideas from concept to shipped feature.

Outcomes

The core outcomes this role is accountable for:

End-to-End Product Design

Design and deliver product experiences that are intuitive, cohesive, and user-centric, communicating design thinking through wireframes, prototypes, sketches, user flows, mockups, and high-fidelity visual designs, and distilling complex problems into systematic, scalable solutions that get refined iteratively.

Usability & Research

Investigate usability pain points and apply UX heuristics to improve clarity and ease of use, and conduct research that informs design decisions, shapes product direction, and surfaces new opportunities.

Design System Ownership

Define, evolve, and maintain Sendmarc’s Design System, keeping the experience consistent and unified across the product ecosystem, and develop the usage guidelines, reusable components, content standards, and usability documentation that let product teams move faster.

Cross-Functional Delivery

Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to plan, design, and implement new features, analysing business rules and technical constraints to keep solutions feasible, presenting design work and adjusting it based on feedback, and supporting engineers through delivery with assets, clarifications, and updates.

Competencies

PRODUCT DESIGN

  • Experience designing end-to-end product experiences, from wireframes and user flows through high-fidelity UI
  • Comfortable distilling complex problems into systematic, scalable design solutions, and refining them iteratively
  • Strong grounding in UX heuristics and usability principles, with a track record of removing friction and confusion from an interface

DESIGN SYSTEMS

  • Experience defining, evolving, and maintaining a design system: components, usage guidelines, content standards
  • Understands how a documented, reusable design system speeds up delivery for the wider product team

COLLABORATION & DELIVERY

  • Comfortable working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to plan and ship new features
  • Able to translate business rules and technical constraints into feasible, effective design solutions
  • Confident presenting design work, gathering feedback, and iterating in response
  • Comfortable supporting engineers through delivery with assets, clarifications, and design updates

TOOLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Tertiary qualification in Design, Interaction Design, HCI, or a related discipline
  • 5+ years hands-on experience designing digital interfaces, preferably for SaaS or B2B products
  • Strong proficiency in Figma and prototyping tools
  • A portfolio demonstrating practical UX and UI design work

Who We're Looking For

You’re a practical, detail-oriented designer who gets real satisfaction from solving an interface problem cleanly and shipping something people find genuinely easy to use. You communicate design thinking clearly, through wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups, and you’re comfortable working closely with Product and Engineering from early concept through to a shipped feature.

SaaS or B2B product experience is a plus, not a requirement: what matters more is a portfolio that shows sharp thinking and polished execution.

About Ethos

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

Design at Ethos

Design at Ethos plays an instrumental role in shaping every aspect of the product. We work across the organization to develop novel solutions to large, interesting challenges, and build world class products that create real value for real people. You will experiment, invent, and occasionally fail but most importantly, you will make and impact and grow in your craft.

About the Role

We’re looking for a seasoned designer with leadership experience to help build the next generation of products at Ethos. This is a player coach role focused on craft at scale. You’ll own some projects but also direct the work of other designers. As part of a team, you’ll help set the bar for quality and impact for the team, and help the team achieve it. You will work across a variety of products and experiences that span our core businesses and expand into new businesses.

Your influence across the team is not limited to ‘mentorship,’ you will be in a position to actively uplevel the output through your feedback, standards and systems that you design and implement.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead design strategy across multiple business units including all aspects of design craft
  • Help set the vision for our overall user experience
  • Direct and guide the work of other designers
  • Build new products and iterate on existing ones
  • Manage executive stakeholders across engineering, product, marketing, and more
  • Drive improvements to the product development process with cross functional partners

Qualifications & Skills:

  • At least 10 years of Product Design experience
  • At least 2 years at a venture-funded, private startup required
  • At least 2 years in a role where you are influencing the work of others either through direct management or indirect leadership
  • Demonstrable impact raising the bar for design practices and output of organizations you have been a member of
  • The majority of your experience is in-house working on direct-to-consumer products
  • You’ve worked in a high-velocity, high-ambiguity, experiment-driven environment - ideally in a Growth Product/Design environment
  • You’ve worked on high consideration consumer flows where storytelling and design craft are meaningful levers for product performance
  • You can clearly articulate the reasoning behind your design decisions. Your work demonstrates intentionality and rigorous thinking
  • A strong portfolio that demonstrates your ability to produce high-quality work, including interaction details, storytelling, visual polish, and content design
  • Experience leading projects end-to-end, including discovery, problem definition, ideation, and validation, all the way through engineering implementation and measurement
  • Experience in improving flows and launching 0-1 products
  • Demonstrated ability to detect process and misalignment issues quickly and work to alleviate them
  • Must be located in Eastern Time Zone

Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche. They are seeking a highly experienced professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer opening.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

This is a full-time, remote independent contractor position.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Product Design team defines and delivers user-facing experiences across Stripe. Product Designers work closely with engineers, product managers, researchers, strategists, operations, data scientists, and marketers to shape products from early strategy through launch and iteration.

You'll join the Risk team, where design shapes how businesses get started on Stripe, stay compliant, and grow with confidence. Stripe's ability to innovate, expand globally, and serve the world's most ambitious companies depends on world-class risk management. But great risk management requires clear, trustworthy, and surprisingly well-crafted experiences during some of the most important moments in a user's relationship with Stripe. From onboarding and verification to account health, your work will help users understand what's happening, know what to do next, and feel confident that Stripe is growing with them as a trusted partner.

Risk at Stripe is also evolving into a product pillar in its own right. As Stripe builds more modular, configurable, API-first risk capabilities, we have the opportunity to turn internal strength into external products for some of the largest and most innovative companies in the world to leverage. This role will shape that future.

What you’ll do

This role sits at the intersection of building trust in the internet economy, platform design, and new product creation, making it one of the most strategically important design opportunities at Stripe. You'll lead design across critical Risk experiences, shaping the strategy for new products, defining AI-driven and agent-friendly workflows, and setting design standards for the team. It's a strong fit for a designer who is energized by ambiguity, motivated by impact, and excited to shape the future of how businesses get started and grow on Stripe.

  • Shape the future of Risk at Stripe, from core user journeys to entirely new product surfaces
  • Design experiences that help users onboard quickly, stay compliant, and manage risk with clarity and control
  • Partner with product, engineering, policy, operations, and research to define both near-term improvements and longer-term opportunities
  • Raise the craft bar in a domain where quality and trust matter deeply
  • Work across dozens of teams to create beautiful patterns for risk and compliance experiences across Stripe

Responsibilities

  • Explore, shape, and prototype new ideas and products
  • Influence strategy through strong product thinking, storytelling, and design judgment
  • Lead design on complex, cross-functional problems with multiple stakeholders and constraints
  • Collaborate across the Risk team and the wider Stripe design team to influence the shape and visual standards for all product surfaces
  • Help other Risk designers and cross-functional partners raise the bar on craft, and adopt systems thinking

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of experience designing products
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent craft, systems thinking, and end-to-end design, including a strong understanding of AI tools
  • Experience leading complex product work in close partnership with product management and engineering
  • Experience shaping ambiguous spaces and driving clarity through design
  • A track record of influencing cross-functional teams and product direction

Preferred qualifications

  • Thrive in environments where the opportunity spans systems, strategy, and 0-1 product thinking
  • Enjoy turning complex systems, policies, and edge cases into elegant product experiences
  • Are energized by ambiguous, strategic problem spaces—not just well-defined execution
  • Are an influential storyteller who can align partners around a clear point of view
  • Can move fluidly between big-picture thinking and interaction-level craft
  • Know how to build trust through design, especially in high-stakes or sensitive user moments

Warp: We're Building the Platform for Agentic Development

Warp began with the vision of reimagining one of the fundamental dev tools, the terminal, to make it more usable and powerful for all developers. As AI has advanced, Warp has evolved beyond its terminal roots into a full agentic development environment: a workbench for dispatching agents to code, deploy, and debug production software.

Today, we have three products. Warp is the agentic development environment born out of the terminal, built on an orchestration platform for running hundreds of cloud agents in parallel. And Warp Factories is our newest product: infrastructure for engineering teams to build and run their own cloud software factories, where fleets of agents triage, spec, implement, review, and verify code across a company's entire SDLC. Together, these products are creating the scaffolding for developers to build their own workflows for working with agents.

In Warp, you can seamlessly switch between running commands, launching agents, and iterating on code with agents, eliminating the need to jump between a terminal and an IDE. It all works with our built in SOTA agent or top agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. On the orchestration side, you can build custom agents that are triggered programmatically, tracked centrally, and shared across full teams to run agents across organizations without compromising security or reliability. Continue a cloud agent run locally in Warp or on the web with one click. And with Warp Factories, teams can go a step further and set up entire automated workflows around their SDLC, retaining full control over their data, models, and compute along the way.

With over 1 million active developers at companies including Docker, Ramp, and Peloton, and over half of the Fortune 500, and revenue that grew over 44x last year, Warp is one of the fastest growing startups in the AI development space.

Our mission has remained the same even as AI has advanced: to empower developers to ship better software more quickly, freeing them to focus on the creative and rewarding aspects of their work. If you want to help define what development looks like in the agentic era at a company where your work reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers every day, we'd love to have you. For more information on our team and culture, we highly recommend reading our' How We Work' guide.

About Simulmedia

Since 2008, Simulmedia has helped brands and agencies turn TV into a measurable growth channel. Our AI-powered media platform for planning, activating, and measuring campaigns works across linear, local, and connected TV.

Everyone here owns problems end-to-end, and our design team is small, so your decisions ship and matter.

About the role

Think about it as a mix of a product manager's mindset with a strong design vertical skills. Design here is AI-first and builder-led. We expect you to take a problem, define ways to solve it, identify the best ways to shape the output, and involve stakeholders throughout the solution's development. Your output might be a Figma design mockup, a prototype, shipped production code, a PRD, or a decision document.

What you'll do

  • Own problems end to end. Define the problem with your PM and engineers, decide what should exist at all, explore options, validate them, and ship improvements that move key metrics. Stay with the work after handoff.
  • Work across the business. Client-facing products, internal tools, sales enablement, or customer experience, depending on priorities.
  • Start in writing. Use AI to clarify hypotheses, surface risks and edge cases, write short PRDs or decision documents. Sometimes the document is the final outcome: not every problem needs a UI solution.
  • Use research to go faster. Talk to sales managers, customer success managers, and internal users, run quick tests, and adjust direction based on what you learn. Use research to speed up decisions, not block them.
  • Prototype with AI. Build and iterate on flows in Claude Code, Cursor, or similar. AI writes the code, and you own structure, behavior, and UX quality.
  • UI Design. When it makes sense, turn validated concepts into production-ready designs with every state covered and aligned with our design system.
  • Ship with engineers. You'll occasionally ship small UI fixes to production; engineers own production code, and your share can grow over time.

What we expect from you

  • 3+ years as a product designer on complex B2B products with dense, data-heavy interfaces: tables, filters, reporting, multi-role flows.
  • A portfolio that shows product thinking, interaction design, and craft
  • At least several products you've built or prototyped in code with AI tools.
  • You proactively build domain and technical knowledge and get up to speed quickly on new problems.
  • Comfort in Claude Code, or similar: you can work in an existing codebase and get a prototype running without waiting for an engineer.
  • Good UI skills: your mockups are neat, balanced, and focused on user value.
  • Based anywhere in Ukraine
  • English at B2+ (upper-intermediate) or higher.

Nice to have

  • Ad tech, media, or analytics/reporting product experience.
  • A public GitHub or shipped side projects.
  • Experience in data visualization
  • Interest in growing your product management and engineering skills alongside design.

How we hire

Apply with a link to your portfolio. The process has three steps:

  1. Technical interview. Walk us through your portfolio and how you work: your research, how you prototype, and the decisions behind one project you built.
  2. Test task. We'd like to understand how you operate within an new domain and are ready to defend your own work
  3. Product manager interview. Product thinking and collaboration: how you define problems and success, prioritize, and work with a PM day to day.

  • Deep understanding of agile development methodologies.

  • Experience in fast paced growing environments, either in start ups or nimble structures.
  • Experience defining and implementing design best practices.

  • Innovative, fast-paced and collaborative culture that values diverse voices and opinions.
  • Learning and development annual budget.
  • Two company-sponsored business trips each year at international destinations we serve!
